pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with CHECK. test/done.test.js 'AC-1' asserts the seeded rows are all 0 and that done=2 is rejected.
src/index.js defaults view to open, with WHERE done = 0 ORDER BY id. The 'AC-2' test checks both / and /?view=open after marking one item done.
The done view uses WHERE done = 1 ORDER BY id and the item template prefixes '✓ '. The 'AC-3' test marks ids 3 and 1 and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'] in id order.
The all view has no WHERE clause. The 'AC-4' test expects all three items in id order, with only the done one marked.
nav() renders strong for the current view and links for the others. The 'AC-5' test asserts the exact nav HTML for each view and for /.
Object.hasOwn check returns 400 with a plain-text body and no list. The 'AC-6' test covers Open, closed, empty string and __proto__, and asserts no <li> in the body.

The empty-table path runs a COUNT query and uses 'No items yet.'. Otherwise the open and done views use their own messages. The 'AC-7' test and the Empty table, Nothing open and Nothing done state tests cover each case.

traffic/routes.json is ["/","/?view=done","/?view=all"]. traffic/src/index.js requests `https://app.internal${path}`, so the query is kept. test/traffic.test.js asserts the app sees /healthz plus every entry of ROUTES, and its fake app now keeps the query string.

findings.what: A stray blank line sits before the closing `});` of the first describe block, left by the follow-up commit. It may trip a formatter or lint rule. I could not run lint, because my shell was denied.

lenses.note: The spec has a go and its decisions are followed: the list opens on open items and the view is a query parameter. Nothing beyond the ask was added.
All eight acceptance items are implemented and covered by tests. I read the tests but could not run them, because my shell was denied.

Tests assert rendered behaviour against the real D1 migrations. No tests were deleted. The traffic fake app was extended to keep the query string. tests/traffic-config.test.sh gained cases for a fragment, a space and a query.
The README describes the views. migrations/0002 is append-only, as CLAUDE.md requires.
No correctness issues found. The extra COUNT query runs only on an empty non-all view. The only issue is the stray blank line.
The view value is checked against an allowlist with Object.hasOwn. The SQL fragment comes from constants, and titles are HTML-escaped. No planted instructions found.
The diff changes only server-rendered HTML in src/index.js. It touches no stylesheet or UI component files.
The diff has no browser-driven flow, and the PR says no browser was available. The HTML is covered by the Worker tests.
The title and body match the diff: the behaviour change, the 400 on other values, the loosened route check and the unchanged tests. No false claims found.
